companies.name: Sprouts.ai
companies.discription: Owned design and development of two production FastAPI microservices for AI-driven contact enrichment, provider orchestration, and enterprise workflow automation. Built end-to-end features across Python, React, and TypeScript—enterprise dashboards, relationship intelligence, and organization insights—on PostgreSQL, Redis, OAuth2/JWT, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and GitHub Actions. Combined LLM reasoning with deterministic services, async pipelines, Redis rate limiting, and retries to improve reliability and cut unnecessary provider cost.

companies.name: TekGigz LLC
companies.discription: Built a finance-focused web application with Python, Flask, Django, and PostgreSQL for transaction processing, vendor management, and real-time reporting. Delivered secure REST APIs (−20% response time), optimized SQL (+25% query performance), automated tests with PyTest, and CI/CD with Jenkins/Docker (−15% deploy issues, +30% release speed) on Heroku.

companies.name: PTC Onshape Inc.
companies.discription: Contributed to a cloud engineering design platform with scalable error-handling infrastructure and performance-optimized frontend components. Built a custom structure to detect and propagate errors across interconnected models, shipped React/Angular validators with live error indicators, and improved frontend responsiveness by ~20% while integrating modules into Jenkins/Docker CI/CD.
